audit_coverage.defect_1_canonical_diagnosis_events: Every diagnosis_event is a literal exact nine-field Event envelope whose prev_hash extends its terminal_record canonical_history.
audit_coverage.defect_2_product_bound_diagnoses: Retryable timeout and invalid candidate diagnoses bind current ResearchService terminal payloads including their exact error objects.
audit_coverage.defect_3_generic_terminal_diagnoses: Every generic canonical terminal state and storage-boundary alias has an exact Diagnosis event that clears its pending obligation.
audit_coverage.defect_4_generic_observation_defaults: Status-only diagnoses freeze canonical status normalization, literal reason fallback, false verification, derived retryability, null metric/numerics, empty gates, and null authority.
audit_coverage.defect_5_nonterminal_exclusion: The RUNNING control remains outside this diagnosis corpus and creates no pending Diagnosis.

policy.generic_terminal_evidence_binding: exact raw EXPERIMENT_STATUS_CHANGED event_id and event_hash
